---
title: "Header test"
author: "Jane Doe^[A footnote in the author field.]"
format:
  pdf:
    number-sections: true
  typst: default
keep-tex: true
keep-typ: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    pdf:
      ensureLatexFileRegexMatches:
        - ['\\section\{Introduction\}', '\\subsection\{First Hypothesis\}', '\\section\{Conclusion\}']
        - []
    typst:
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        - ['^  title: \[Header test', '^= Introduction', '^== First Hypothesis', '^= Conclusion']
        - ['^  title: \[Introduction\]']
---

A footnote in `author` must not hide the level-1 headings from the detector that decides whether to shift heading levels. PDF only shifts with `number-sections`, while Typst shifts without it, so Typst is rendered unnumbered here.

# Introduction

Body.

## First Hypothesis

Body.

# Conclusion

Body.
